==Acquisition==
Temporarily, as one of the five skills available while under the effect of [[Volfen Blessing]].

==Notes==
*The description is somewhat confusing. Volfen Pounce actually deals {{gr2|60|100}} damage one second after being adjacent to a foe. This means that activating it while [[attack]]ing might end it prematurely before it can do so.
